title: Hold mutations until a matching human approval exists
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. A privileged mutate is gated by JudgementPolicy: without a matching approval digest the walk raises human review onto walk-bag register `ask`. The story step expects that request and injects the approval into `ans`; the second decide allows. ASK_HUMAN path for Dots MH-DOTS-04[^insp-dots-04-pending] and approval interrupt for MH-DOTS-02[^insp-dots-02-review].
implementation:
`WalkBag` / `WalkBagRegister` (`ask`/`ans`) in `mechaharness.walk_bag`; `HumanReviewGateVerb` (`human_review_gate`) in `cli_policy_verbs` over `JudgementPolicy.require_approval_for` + `decide()`; story `expect` kind `human_review` with `inject` folded into the verb by the user_story harness.

Covers: POL-04, GAT-04.
validation: Harness `user_story` walks `human_review_gate` with `expect: human_review` + inject; hard expects on `verdict_kinds` / `final_verdict`.
